answer: Registration uses a bonding curve: the first identity per funding cluster burns 10 tokens, and each later one burns 10 plus 5 per existing member, so n fakes cost 10n+2.5n(n-1). A prism of near-identical accounts gets clustered by shared funding paths, and a terrace of five witnesses signs each epoch's cluster roots. Anyone can recompute them from the karst of ledger transfers.
